+  const generatedId = 'generated-request-id'

+  const app = new Hono()
+  app.use('/default', requestId({ generator: () => generatedId }))
+  app.use('/trust', requestId({ generator: () => generatedId, trustIncoming: true }))
+  app.use('/untrust', requestId({ generator: () => generatedId, trustIncoming: false }))
+  app.get('/default', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+  app.get('/trust', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+  app.get('/untrust', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+  it('Should use incoming request id by default', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/default', {
+      headers: {

Done.

Changes in `src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`:
- Added `trustIncoming?: boolean` to `RequestIdOptions`.
- Defaulted it to `true` so existing behavior is unchanged.
- When `false`, the incoming header is ignored and `generator` is always used; the generated value is still set via `c.set('requestId', ...)` and written to the response header.
- Documented the option in the JSDoc.

Tests in `src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts` now cover:
- Incoming ID used by default.
- Incoming ID used when `trustIncoming: true`.
- Incoming ID ignored (generator used) when `trustIncoming: false`, verified through both `c.get('requestId')` and the response header.
- Generator used when `trustIncoming: false` and no header is sent.

`pnpm exec vp test --run src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts` passes: 1 file, 15 tests.
